articles.title: Satoshi’s 1.1M bitcoin and millions more can be saved from quantum attack, says expert
articles.snippet: Researchers at the privacy-centric blockchain startup say their multi-layer quantum defense will feature a soft fork to freeze and protect dormant BTC.

articles.title: Mark Cuban says he sold most of his Bitcoin after failed hedge narrative 'disappointed' the billionaire
articles.snippet: The billionaire investor said he sold most of his bitcoin after concluding the cryptocurrency failed to act as a hedge during recent geopolitical turmoil and dollar weakness.

articles.title: Ethereum’s identity crisis is deepening after high-profile 'brain drain' frustrates the community
articles.snippet: What began earlier this week as shock over more exits of core figures has now evolved into something more existential, according to some community members.

articles.title: Crypto prediction markets are turning into dangerous national security risks, and Congress wants to ban them
articles.snippet: Bubblemaps investigators led by Nicolas Vaiman, discovered 80 bets on Polymarket with a 98% win rate that he said is statistically impossible to achieve.

articles.title: U.S. CFTC secures deal with National Hockey League on prediction market safeguards
articles.snippet: A new arrangement has been set between the derivatives regulator and professional hockey, following on the heels of a similar baseball agreement.
